ROUTING: outpatient management after acute symptoms resolve; initiate urate-lowering therapy only after flare resolution and baseline renal function assessment  
SAFETY-NET: Monitor for persistent pain/swelling beyond 7–10 days; seek urgent care if signs of infection (fever, red streaks) or renal impairment develop. Do not restart allopurinol during acute flare—typically started at low dose after resolution.
